Method of Attack: Encrypts files using Rijndael symmetric key encryption with a hardcoded key
Infects USB flash drives by copying itself as Update.exe to root folder
Hides original files on USB drives and replaces them with Windows shortcuts (LNK files) that launch ransomware payload
Creates visible copies of itself on USB drives with Arabic names to lure victims
Includes a failsafe to skip encryption on specific machine names
Attack Vector: USB flash drives infection via removable drives and Windows shortcuts (LNK files)
Indicators of Compromise: Windows shortcuts (LNK files) with arrows on icons
Arabic named copies of ransomware on USB drives
